sloka: तमेनं मायिनं क्षुद्रमन्तर्हितरथं बलात्।राक्षसं निहनिष्यन्ति दृष्ट्वा वानरयूथपाः ।। ६.८०.४१ ।।
transliteration: tamenaṁ māyinaṁ kṣudramantarhitarathaṁ balāt।rākṣasaṁ nihaniṣyanti dṛṣṭvā vānarayūthapāḥ ।। 6.80.41 ।।

translations.english: " A conjurer, mean, and invisible Indrajith with the chariot, if seen, in any way the Vanara troops will forcibly kill him with their strength."
